title: Digital Scholarly Edition of Angelo Poliziano's Marginal Notes to the Epistle of Sappho to Phaon
institution: Università di Salerno, Sapienza Università di Roma, Università di Napoli Federico II, Università di Torino, CNR-ILC
notes:
EVT 2-based digital scholarly edition encoding multiple edition levels of Poliziano's manuscript annotations on the Epistle of Sappho to Phaon, with Wikidata items and CTS URNs; the dataset is also deposited on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.17315766). It is a single-work edition, but carries a full scholarly apparatus (diplomatic and critical layers, apparatus of marks), so it is included despite the single-author caveat.

Justification: A peer-reviewed (Journal of Open Humanities Data, 2025) TEI digital scholarly edition of a 15th-century Renaissance manuscript annotation corpus. Found via Zenodo and Journal of Open Humanities Data search results. Not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://openhumanitiesdata.metajnl.com/articles/10.5334/johd.493
